- lesson: nonempty string

- array values for evidence/ref fields must be exact IDs, never evidence summaries or prose

For recommended_state_transition or recommended_next_operation, copy exactly one allowed value with no new label. Use evidence_refs only from evidence_for IDs: e_completed_prior_work, e_unresolved_research_need, e_unresolved_restart_need. Contrary evidence may inform the summary, but do not add a contrary_evidence_considered field Empty strings are invalid for required text fields. The uncertainty value must be a nonempty phrase naming what remains unresolved. Do not copy field descriptions as answers. Do not claim the loop, task, system, or episode is successful or complete. Do not choose declare_insufficient_evidence when both evidence_for and contrary_evidence are supplied.
